title: Zesty Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado
description: A sweet, crunchy, monsoon-inspired keto-friendly Peruvian dish that features vanilla pod and a salt-bake flavor. It is quick to prepare and delivers a satisfying burst of zesty flavors.
instructions: Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until shimmering, then add olive oil.
Add the sliced beef, season with sea salt and ground cumin, sear for 1-2 minutes per side until browned but still juicy, remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add sliced bell pepper and onion, sauté for 3 minutes until slightly softened.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return the beef to the skillet, pour tamari, lime juice, and vanilla pod scrape, stir to coat, and cook for 1 minute.
Remove the vanilla pod, reduce heat to medium, sprinkle chopped roasted almonds, and stir to combine.
Serve immediately, optionally over cauliflower rice, and drizzle extra tamari if desired.
Garnish with additional sea salt if desired.
